official_sources.title: Chalkboard Daily Fantasy Sports Official Rules

observed_public_facts: The public rules list Texas among eligible states and generally require age 18 or older, with account, identity, banking, and geolocation requirements.
A valid entry uses 2 through 8 player picks, at least two teams, a minimum entry of $1, and an account-visible multiplier; maximum entry can vary.
Every leg has its own multiplier and the complete entry multiplier determines the potential prize.
A tied or DNP leg is voided; entries with three or more legs are regraded with an adjusted payout, while a two-leg entry with a DNP is refunded.
The public terms prohibit automated scraping of product pages.
